candidate.user_input: What is the recommended initial onboarding duration at GitLab and when does team-specific training typically begin?
candidate.reference: We highly recommend taking at least two full weeks for onboarding and only in week three starting with team specific onboarding and training.

evidence.quote: We highly recommend taking at least two full weeks for onboarding and only in week three starting with team specific onboarding and training.
evidence.contribution: This quote directly states the recommended onboarding duration and when team-specific training starts.

candidate.connection: The quote explicitly provides the recommended onboarding duration and timing for team-specific training, matching the question focus.

source_conditions: Onboarding is highly recommended to last at least two full weeks.
Team-specific onboarding and training is recommended to start only in week three.
Participation in team work during the first two weeks is allowed but heavy contribution is not expected.
The recommendation is not a mandate.
